# Twilio fixtures

Responses in the shape Twilio documents for its Messages API
(https://www.twilio.com/docs/messaging/api/message-resource#create-a-message-resource)
and the form fields of its incoming-message webhook
(https://www.twilio.com/docs/messaging/guides/webhook-request). They are written
from the documentation, not captured from a live account; identifiers and
numbers are synthetic. Cabin sends no texts until the owner's US A2P 10DLC
registration is done and the owner's Twilio account is connected.
